P01.note: Brushwork hidden 'through the glaze' decides clouded; the black on the cloth is wipeable soot, so blackened is the near-miss. Smooth-as-glass kills blistered, held-tea kills cracked.

P02.note: Paid draftsmen still on the rival's payroll plus models arriving weeks before the rival's matching ones point to infiltrated; mimicked is the near-miss since the designs were copied, but via insiders and ahead of the rival.

P03.note: Standing committee, files in the safe, couriers dispatched decide headquarters; hub is weakened by 'no other exile was let into the room', hothouse by leaders unchanged since before the war, embassy has no representative function.

P04.note: 'Raised on a bank through the middle of the town, between the mill and the streets' nearly states fragmented; population held at eight thousand kills drained and engulfed, and the new grocery/school/fire company kills fossilized.

P05.note: Rare books gone, ordinary left, stamped volumes surfacing in the occupier's universities decide plundered; purged needs an ideological removal never mentioned, pulped is killed by the books turning up.

P06.note: Icy bodies absorbed and rocky planets hit twenty times less often gives umbrella; 'hardly any icy body left the system' kills slingshot and the 'ragged inner edge' kills shepherd.

P07.note: Neighbours matching within two years and traders quoting its rate make it the pacemaker; four cuts kill ratchet, the fourfold rise undercuts pendulum, regulator is a near-miss but changes followed treasury need, not market steadying.

P08.note: D 'overran' is struck on grammar alone: 'had overran' is not English (needs the participle 'overrun'). 400 to 1,900 nearly hands over repopulated; 'main street still facing the river landing' kills reoriented.

P09.note: Price swinging less than nearby towns decides ballast; backstop is the near-miss (a year's grain in reserve) but it sold every spring, not in emergencies. Cudgel struck on a surface read: a weapon has nothing to do with a granary; 'neither profit nor loss' kills coffer.

P10.note: Half the small crews quitting and a single storm leaving nothing to sell decide stifled; that same line kills both saturated and steadied, and uprooted only literally describes crews moving to canneries.

P11.note: Each distractor dies to one planted phrase: 'let the union stand' and growth to nine thousand kill disbanded and doomed, 'voted almost to a man' kills divided; 'never again stopped work' plus 'in effect' hands over defanged.

P12.note: Females denning in the bank spring to late summer with young born there decides lair; 'hunted in the oak woods' kills larder and 'crossing the open fields' kills lane, inn fails on season-long residence.

P13.note: 'Families slept in them on nights the sirens sounded' hands over bunker in one sentence. On a surface read bazaar (nothing commercial anywhere) and arena (no spectacle, the floor is a pond) are off-topic; cesspool dies to 'clear to its gravel bed'.

P14.note: Riffles dry while the bends keep depth and crowd with trout decides pooled; parched is the literal fit for the white riffles, overheated dies to shaded seepage and survival, pinched is the near-miss without the pool image.

P15.note: Small fenced kit plant before a fortyfold expansion decides toehold; warehouse literally fits the freight yard and crates, managers sent from abroad kill schoolhouse, and the single dealer weakens showroom.

P16.note: 'Salmon dig their nests in that bar, and the young stay in the gravel' nearly states hatchery; hostel is the near-miss, highway dies to deer wading below rather than crossing on the log.

P17.note: The five-year gap matching the famine reads as savings drawn on in hard times, so insurance; local coins and local-style jewelry kill loot, kitty is the near-miss (a pooled fund).

P18.note: Merchant's son merged into the saint's boy with episodes alternating decides fused; 'still set in the desert capital' kills domesticated, and twice the length plus disputed order kill distilled and honed.

P19.note: Dark silt over the salt crust and a gain that faded each harvest decide replenished; rinsed is the near-miss but silt covered rather than washed the crust, and 'same seed wheat' kills reseeded.

P20.note: Bare rock grooved downhill with debris swept offshore decides scoured; the askew breakwater is a literal lure for tilted, but benchmarks at 1880 height kill tilted and submerged, bare rock kills smothered.

P21.note: 'A reader ... in any city met the same names' hands over homogenized in one sentence; fractured is struck as the opposite end of the pair, and radio reading the papers' stories only after publication weakens dethroned.

P22.note: Walled crown that raiders tried and abandoned decides citadel; ark is the near-miss (families and cattle ferried over) undercut by 'seldom rises more than a foot', and the unwadeable, untieable channel kills crossing and anchorage.

P23.note: Yield printed at the head of the report with visits to farms a fifth below decides yardstick; 'one strain ... same methods every year' kills testbed and selling to a flour mill kills wellspring and stopgap.

P24.note: The keeper now needing a boat plus the tide arriving through a new path while the old mouth silted means the spit was breached: cleaved. 'As wide as before' kills broadened, tip unchanged kills blunted.

P25.note: Houses older than 1650 when raiders burned the coast imply the bar kept ships out: barricade. Swells pouring over kill breakwater, a ledge that never uncovers kills causeway, chokepoint is a near-miss.

P26.note: 'The village kept its butter and meat there through the summer' hands over cooler in one sentence. Bellows is struck on a surface read (nothing pumps air); 'only opening' kills chimney, draining through cracks kills cistern.

P27.note: Bacterium killing nine in ten uninfected but one in ten infected decides immunized; equal duck predation kills the classic manipulated, and 'slightly' fewer eggs and slower growth kill neutered and milked.

P28.note: Walled layers of uncut human bones with an antler laid on each decide mortuary; the ledge over the ford lures lookout and the cold chamber lures icebox, while camps by the river kill lodge.

P29.note: Biota 'of every lake nearby' plus results taken as what would happen to the region's lakes decide microcosm; churned layers kill ledger, museum and metronome lack support.

P30.note: Splinter party founding a temple whose head the city abbot names decides offshoot; built later kills precursor, farmhouse style kills replica, the abbot's appointment kills rival.

P31.note: Cold bottom outlet keeping ponds from freezing or overheating decides thermostat; outflow tracking inflow within a day kills valve and sink, tributary inverts the relation.

P32.note: Birds standing along the edge between dives and leaving when the lane packs decides perch; roof literally fits the cover, fast ice that never moves kills raft, nothing growing beneath kills pantry.

P33.note: Fortress fits barracks and a garrison holding out months, but fleets sailing past to burn the cities means it never protected them, and depot is equally defensible from the twice-stressed warehouses of powder and grain. Not exclusive.

P34.note: Washing, evening walks, skating by half the city, houses from every quarter decide commons; low footbridges every hundred yards undercut artery and kill border, aqueduct lacks support.

P35.note: Wages replaced by fixed yearly sums from forty households decides leased; the 1858 inventory with oak woods intact kills logged and liquidated, money coming in rather than out kills mortgaged.

P36.note: Families stopping singing to listen, few under forty knowing a line, decides silenced; 'every verse and every rough voice' kills stripped and smoothed, transplanted has no movement.

P37.note: New channel with no crossing until 1963 between villages and fields decides marooned; fresh silt lures nourished, but fields unsown eleven years kill it and irrigated.

P38.note: 'Laid the paint layer ... onto light canvas' nearly defines transferred; leaving the darkened varnish kills uncovered and scrubbed, 'sound oak' kills stabilized.

P39.note: Year-round shops buying from one caravan and selling to the next decide emporium; 'all year' weakens fairground, gatehouse and estate lack support.

P40.note: Taken from above bench by bench, summit four hundred feet lower, decides razed; no tunnels kills riddled, flat shelf kills pitted, rising trout kill poisoned.
